display_title: ERAS: endoplasmic-reticulum-stress gene signatures in lung adenocarcinoma
summary: Retrospective transcriptomic modeling defined a 10-gene ERAS signature, evaluated it across TCGA and GEO datasets, and assessed two model genes in 10 paired LUAD specimens. Treatment-response analyses were computational.
research_question: Can an endoplasmic-reticulum-stress gene signature stratify overall-survival prognosis in retrospective LUAD transcriptomic cohorts?
author_summary: The study combined LUAD single-cell and bulk transcriptomic datasets to investigate endoplasmic reticulum stress. Twenty-two survival-associated genes were reduced to a 10-gene ERAS signature using LASSO in TCGA. The authors examined survival stratification in TCGA and seven named GEO datasets, and combined ERAS with age and stage in a nomogram. The reported nomogram AUCs were 0.740, 0.754 and 0.754 at 1, 3 and 5 years. Expression of SERPINH1 and GPR37 was assessed by qPCR in 10 paired tumor and adjacent specimens. Immune scores and drug sensitivities were inferred from molecular data; this does not establish that using ERAS to choose treatment improves outcomes.

study_profile.counting_note: Datasets and specimen pairs are distinct units. No unique pooled participant total is derived. The Results text calls the external survival datasets six but enumerates seven; Methods and Figure 4C identify TCGA plus seven GEO datasets. External evaluation here means retrospective public-dataset assessment, not prospective clinical validation; cross-dataset participant overlap was not independently reconstructed.

qa.answer: The nomogram AUCs were 0.740, 0.754 and 0.754 at 1, 3 and 5 years in the reported retrospective evaluation.

limitations: Retrospective public data and heterogeneous molecular datasets limit clinical transportability.
No prospective ERAS-guided intervention was evaluated; public-dataset survival separation and retrospective AUCs do not establish clinical utility.
The Results text calls seven named GEO cohorts six. Methods and Figure 4C identify the seven named GEO datasets; no pooled participant total is inferred.

Survival separation was not uniformly significant: Figure 4C reports a log-rank P value of 0.091 for GSE29016. The study should not be cited as significant prognostic validation in every external dataset.

Immune-infiltration and TMB group differences described in Results include nonsignificant comparisons; computational immune and drug-sensitivity estimates are not observed treatment-response validation.
The qPCR experiment assesses two genes in 10 paired tissue specimens; it does not validate the complete survival model or establish that these genes cause tumor progression.
The selected figures were checked for labels, reported values and direction, without reanalysis of participant-level or raw qPCR data.

related_papers.relationship: Related LUAD prognostic modeling using a distinct immunotherapy-associated signature; not independent confirmation of ERAS.
